evidence_rule: Only phase=full and the once-opened test split may decide Gate C; smoke and validation are not manuscript evidence.
split_rule: Seeds 0-2 calibration, 3-4 validation, 5-9 test. Model fitting is seed-local; thresholds never see validation/test outcomes.
threshold_rule: For every dataset-model stratum, the 0.95 higher empirical quantile of independent explanation-score no-shift calibration trials is frozen and applied unchanged to both independent and paired channels. Input, output, and Explanation Shift baselines each receive their own calibration-only threshold.

criteria.comparison: paired minus independent test no-shift FAR under the same independent-calibrated threshold
validation paired FAR does not exceed independent FAR and paired power loss is no worse than 0.05
Explanation Shift, input-space, and output-space detector scores, FAR, power, AUROC, AUPRC, confusion counts, and delay are complete on identical trials
split disjointness, frozen threshold hashes, official skshift semantic smoke, marginal-stream identity, atomic coverage, finite values, and independent artefact validation all pass

gate_rule: PASS only if C1-C7 all pass. Detector superiority may be claimed only for a baseline whose paired-minus-baseline interval supports it; baseline completeness alone is not superiority.
